primary.usage: Main CTAs, Active States, Brand Elements

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky Headers, Floating Action Buttons, Modal Overlays, Featured Cards

rtl_strategy.margins: mr-auto (instead of ml-auto for pushing left)
rtl_strategy.icons: Mirror directional icons (arrows), keep universal icons (play, check) standard

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-bold shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/25 transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-primary border-2 border-primary/10 hover:border-primary/30 hover:bg-purple-50 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium transition-all duration-300

cards.base: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/50 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 group

inputs.style: bg-white/50 border-purple-100 focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/10 rounded-2xl h-12 text-right

navigation.mobile: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-purple-100 h-20 flex items-center justify-around z-50 pb-2
navigation.desktop: sticky top-4 mx-auto max-w-7xl bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 rounded-full px-8 py-4 shadow-sm z-50 flex justify-between items-center mt-4

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALLATION: Run 'yarn add lucide-react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge @radix-ui/react-slot class-variance-authority' immediately.
2. FONT: Add the Tajawal Google Font link to public/index.html head.
3. RTL: Add 'dir="rtl"' to the <html> tag in public/index.html.
4. THEME: Update src/index.css with the CSS variables provided in 'colors.css_variables'.
5. TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to extend colors with the CSS variables and add 'rounded-3xl' as default radius.
6. LAYOUT: Build the 'AppLayout' component first, handling the mobile bottom nav and desktop top nav logic.
7. GLASSMORPHISM: Create a reusable 'GlassCard' component using the visual_enhancers.glassmorphism classes.
8. MOCK DATA: Create a 'mockData.js' file for listings, users, and governorates (Damascus, Aleppo, Homs, etc.) to populate the UI.
9. AI FEATURE: Mock the Gemini suggestion in the 'Add Offer' flow using a timeout and a predefined list of suggestions.
10. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Ensure all text has high contrast against the Pearl White background.
Never use pure black (#000000); use the deep purple-grey provided.
Animations should be smooth (duration-300) and triggered on hover/focus.
